notes.title: v1.0.1 Bugfix
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280090/830f3fdab2086f6728240937cc4e2438f3a9c1ce.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the effect of the relic Flower Vase would not trigger on tiles occupied by enemy units.
[*] Fixed a UI clipping issue in certain language settings.
[*] Improved translation quality for some in-game texts.
[/list]

If you find any bugs, feel free to contact us at vasrakgames@gmail.com. Thank you!
